summary.text: In a 2023 fact sheet, the Department of Defense said it had been investing in AI and responsibly fielding data- and AI-enabled systems for over 60 years. The 2023 DoD Data, Analytics, and AI Adoption Strategy built on and superseded the 2018 AI Strategy and 2020 Data Strategy, focusing on goals supporting an AI Hierarchy of Needs with Responsible AI at the top consistent with DoD AI Ethical Principles. A January 2026 release announced an AI Acceleration Strategy to extend the U.S. lead in military AI deployment and integrate frontier AI capabilities across mission areas. The Department also described no-cost GenAI.mil training for employees and Department-wide access to frontier generative AI models at Impact Level 5 and above.
